statusKey.AGREE: both map the muscle; the package bucket reads as our category and relationship, and the modes match
statusKey.AGREE-CATEGORY: same counted category, different relationship word
statusKey.DISAGREE: both map the muscle; categories differ
statusKey.PACKAGE-ONLY: package grades the muscle; we have no mapping row
statusKey.OURS-ONLY: we map the muscle; package cell is null (unmodeled)
statusKey.-DRAFT suffix: our mapping is draft: shown pending review, never counted (02-design.md:64)

gradeToRelationship.4: direct (dynamic target, or the target of a deliberate hold)
gradeToRelationship.3: contributing (used only for BR in fa-28, fa-29, fa-42, all supporting_dynamic; ours has no 3-vs-2 distinction)
gradeToRelationship.2: no single relationship: contributing (supporting_dynamic), stabilizer (supporting_isometric) or incidental (incidental_grip); the bucket, not the grade, carries the relationship
gradeToRelationship.1: none (unused in the seed); nearest is a draft mapping
gradeToRelationship.0: none (reserved, unused): we have no per-muscle 'reviewed exclusion' record, only absence and the per-exercise unmapped list (unmapped.ts:145-170)
gradeToRelationship.null: no mapping row (our absence); NOT our 'unknown' category, which is a mapping whose relationship or mode is unknown (rules.ts:51)

whereTheyDoNotLineUp: Grade and 0-100 index: no counterpart. The atlas keeps raw categories with no weight, no fractional sets and no percentage split (02-design.md:68; mappings.ts:24).

supporting_isometric and incidental_grip both fall into our incidental_isometric category (rules.ts:61; label 'Incidental grip / stabilization', rules.ts:77); only our relationship word (stabilizer vs incidental) keeps them apart.

Our deliberate_isometric is 'direct OR contributing, isometric, on a deliberate-hold variant' (rules.ts:60; 02-design.md:44). A package supporting_isometric cell on a hold (FPL in fa-21, fa-33, fa-43) would therefore count as a deliberate hold if written as our contributing; it must be written as stabilizer to stay supporting.

The package's supportingExerciseExposure (START-HERE:300) is the union of supporting_dynamic and supporting_isometric; ours counts contributing_dynamic on its own and stabilizing inside incidental_isometric, so that field needs relationship-level reading, not our categories.
We have mixed (one bout, two categories, rules.ts:28) and unknown categories; the package has neither: one cell per muscle and record, and unmodeled for everything else.
Our allocation (individual/shared: FDS with FDP, PT with PQ, the deviators) has no package field; the package grades FDS and FDP identically everywhere, which is compatible with shared.

Our requiresNoStraps is per grip mapping (02-design.md:60); the package has straps only as required context and its engine drops the whole limb bout as unresolved when grip-assisted (reference_engine.py:91-93).
Package contraction 'dynamic_concentric_eccentric' is our muscleMode 'dynamic' plus the variant's phase (variants/forearm.ts:71-86); 'isometric' is 'isometric'.

Per-cell confidence ('low' on all 393 mapped cells) and the record status (all 50 'draft_mapping') have no counterpart in our per-mapping reviewStatus, evidenceBasis and sources with locator and limitation (types.ts:360-376). Under the package's own rules none of its cells is publishable yet.
No action id on a package cell; every one of our mappings names one node action (05-mappings.md:279). A stabilizer cell needs one chosen (e.g. wrist.flexion for an FCR stabilizer).
Tissue units, regional groups and tissue_exposure_grade have no counterpart in our model.

findingsInBrief: OURS-ONLY is zero on the 24 compared records: every forearm muscle we map on a matched exercise, the package maps too. Our extra rows are the upper-arm externals (biceps, brachialis), outside the package's 19.

PACKAGE-ONLY (94 cells on the 24 compared records) is four systematic additions: FPL on every handle grip (20 records: 17 incidental_grip, fa-41/fa-44 supporting_isometric, fa-47 supporting_dynamic); FCR and FCU as wrist stabilizers, supporting_isometric (17 records each: curls, rows, RDL, hangs, carries, levers, pinch, gripper); ECRL, ECRB and ECU as stabilizers where we have none (13 records each: hammer and supinated curls, rows, RDL, hangs, levers, pinch, gripper; we credit them only on 135, 136, 145, 299, 409); PQ supporting_isometric in lever supination (fa-18).

DISAGREE (5): FDS/FDP in the wrist curl (fa-01 vs 139, fa-11 vs 410): package supporting_dynamic (grade 2), ours incidental isometric grip; BR in the thick-grip supinated barbell curl (fa-08 vs 121): package direct_dynamic grade 4, ours contributing dynamic (mappings.ts:142).

DISAGREE-DRAFT (3): FPL in fa-21 (299), fa-33 (409), fa-43 (144): package supporting_isometric; ours contributing isometric draft, which our rule would count as deliberate_isometric if reviewed as written.
AGREE-CATEGORY (2): FDS/FDP in the towel pull-up (fa-42 vs 78): package incidental_grip, ours contributing isometric; both count as incidental_isometric.

The package's thumb coverage gap (START-HERE section 4.1) is already closed in the catalog: 412 Band Thumb Flexion (FPL), 413 Band Thumb Extension (EPL/EPB shared), 414 Band Thumb Abduction (APL), 404 Band Finger Extension (ED direct, EDM/EI contributing), all reviewed (mappings.ts:290-296). The package has no record for any of them.

The package's Example A (two wrist curls and a 20 s farmer hold, START-HERE:341-347) does not reproduce under forearm_mappings_v1: FCR/FCU get no carry bout (no flexor stabilizer mapping), FDS/FDP get two incidental bouts, not two supporting dynamic bouts, and FPL gets nothing counted (wrist curls unmapped for FPL; the carry's FPL row is draft).
